caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of woven textile placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The textile features a pattern composed of various rectangular and square shapes, created by alternating dark blue and light brownish-beige threads. The left side of the textile displays a more intricate, checkerboard-like design, while the right side consists of more regular vertical and horizontal bands forming larger squares. The textile’s top edge is uneven, with several blue threads extending and curling upward beyond the main rectangle, and the bottom edge is fringed with a mix of beige and blue loose threads. The signature “R. Marangelli” appears in small blue letters in the lower right corner of the background, outside the textile.
title: Homespun Wool
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
